summary: Regeneron filed an 8-K reporting a Sixth Amendment, dated October 1, 2026, to its 2009 Antibody License and Collaboration Agreement with Sanofi Biotechnology and Sanofi. The parties will co-develop and co-commercialize four new Regeneron-invented long-acting antibodies (IL-13, IL-4, IL-4Rα, and an IL-4xIL-13 bispecific), with Sanofi paying a $1.0 billion upfront plus up to $7.0 billion in development, regulatory, and commercial milestones; global profits and development costs split equally. Regeneron holds an asset-by-asset option on Sanofi's lunsekimig and one other early-stage product. This is a routine collaboration expansion, not a special situation.
